_comment: Copy to <org root>/.agent-mail/roster.json and fill in. Delete this key.
This file is the single source of identity for the whole network, and when
two developers federate it is also the CONTRACT BETWEEN THEM: it travels
inside the shared .agent-mail repo, so the second person's setup reads it
and learns the site handles, the seat names and which projects are shared
instead of guessing or asking again.
Absolute paths only. A relative 'home' silently produces a seat that never
